node.title: Re^9: Doing every X seconds
node.author: anonymized user 468275
node.doctext:
Convenient to say that we are not talking about something as an excuse for ignoring my point. I have stated a reasonable criteria for error checking. So the next time I try to help someone on this site with something relatively simple, clearly I can expect this kind trolling - "oh you didn't check e.g. close $fh for an error code in your example program".

What you people have done is made it impossible to help OPs without feeding the trolls.

One world, one people
